title: Scan QR code
instruction: Position QR code within the frame
permissionDesc: SweatDrop needs camera access to scan QR codes on equipment. Please grant permission to continue.
permissionRestrictedDesc: Camera access is restricted on this device. Please contact your administrator or enable it in Settings.
permissionErrorDesc: Failed to request camera permissions. Please try again or enable camera access in Settings.
machineNotFoundDesc: QR code is not valid or the machine is not active. Please check.
machineUnavailableDesc: This machine is currently under maintenance. Please use another machine.
machineBusyDesc: This machine is currently in use. Please wait or use another machine.
machineBusyOtherDesc: Someone else is using this machine right now. Please use another machine.
previousWorkoutOpenDesc: It looks like a previous workout didn't finish. Close it to start a new one — any drops you earned will still be credited.
recoveryFailedDesc: Please try again. If the problem persists, restart the app.
sensorNotPairedDesc: This machine does not have a paired sensor. Please contact an administrator to pair a sensor before starting a workout.
errorProcessing: An error occurred while scanning the QR code. Please try again.
errorWorkout: An error occurred while starting the workout. Please try again.
devModeNotFound: Development machine with QR UUID {{uuid}} not found. Please check DEV_QR_UUID in ScannerScreen.tsx
devSimSubtitleMachine: Select machine type and configure settings.
invalidQRDesc: This QR code is not recognized. Please try another machine.
switchGymDesc: This machine belongs to {{gymName}}. Do you want to switch?
nearLimitBanner: You've used {{used}} of {{max}} rewarded sessions today. This may be your last.
limitReachedBanner: You've earned {{earned}} drops today — daily limit reached. Workout will be tracked without drops.
softSessionBanner: You've completed {{count}} sessions today. Keep going — drops are still active!
